author: Krozz_08
body:
* Ljosalfar Sceptre 

* Balor Crown/Witch Hat

* Fallen Shield (mammon)/Arisen witch scroll/Mighty Griffin Shield

* Immortal Tunic 

* Viper Mage's Boots 

* Two Immortal Ring 

All of the armor need immortal jewel, and ljosalfar sceptre need any jewels with hp/ward or magic.

Get your first 15k tower shards and buy omnimancer ara, and with that you're ready for towers , having good def and res, hp and ward 

Buy breathing armor (t8) too, or if you have stoneward, it's better

author: IncredibleDongle
body: Don’t go crazy upgrading gear, T10 will come sooner than you think and all that early game stuff will have been a waste. Definitely don’t master forge the yeti overcoat, you’ll want to get a Fey Yeti coat to replace that very soon.
